nodes.long_description:
XeeXR Remote Guidance lets trainers, experts and clients view a user's session in a compatible VR, AR or MR app on a supported Meta Quest VR headset and communicate through two-way audio.

The app runs on the headset while its live view streams over the internet to the XeeXR Dashboard in a browser. Participants can be at different locations and on different networks. The remote participant needs neither a second VR headset nor a copy of the external app.

Designed for businesses and organizations, Remote Guidance supports training, simulation, product demonstrations, BIM and CAD reviews and user support.

How to get started

1.	Create your account at portal.gotoviar.com and open the XeeXR Dashboard.

2.	Install XeeXR Remote Guidance on your supported Meta Quest VR headset.

3.	Add a Remote Guidance app in the dashboard, name it and generate a QR code.

4.	Open Remote Guidance on the headset and scan the QR code to pair the app.

5.	Click "Connect" in the dashboard and "Start Session" in the headset app. Either order works. Then open the external VR, AR or MR app.

Requires an active XeeXR account, dashboard access, a compatible external app, a suitable browser and internet connection. Functionality depends on the headset, firmware, external app, browser, network and XeeXR release.

XeeXR is a product developed by GOTOVIAR.
nodes.short_description: View VR, AR and MR apps live from a Meta Quest VR headset in your browser. Use two-way audio for remote training, reviews and support.

nodes.change_log:
This is a major update with a rebuilt connection system for more reliable remote guidance sessions.

New
• System audio sharing: the remote expert can now hear the sound from apps running on your headset, and can turn it on or off at any time
• Remote Guidance now runs as a background service: share your headset view and voice while you keep using other apps

Improvements
• Sessions can now connect on more networks, including restricted company and guest Wi-Fi
• Faster, more stable connections that recover automatically if the network drops
• Improved audio and video streaming
• Clearer voice on unstable networks: short audio dropouts are now filled in automatically
• Clearer pairing messages: if pairing fails, the app now says why (for example an expired or already used QR code, a QR code made for another app, or no network connection)
• Messages now stay on screen long enough to read them in the headset
• The QR scanner now uses a new rendering engine (Vulkan through WebGPU)

Changes
• Hand tracking is no longer supported: use your Touch controllers to scan the pairing QR code

Fixes
• Ending a session now correctly disconnects the other participant
• The web dashboard now shows your headset view again after you stop and restart a session, after the headset sleeps, or after the network drops, with no page reload needed
• Fixed a problem where a dropped connection could keep reconnecting in a loop
• Fixed a problem that could cause audio glitches when sharing your microphone or headset sound
